sy_p: Elevation tokens and components. Everything in the platform comes from here. Contrast ratios are computed from the real values in the theme you have active.

sy_ty2: Capability names and platform voice: Spectral italic
sy_ty3: Body text: Barlow, 17 px, line height 1.55
sy_ty_s: Typeface licences: to be confirmed before production.
sy_btn_p: One primary button per view. Buttons say what happens. Minimum height 46 px.
sy_ban1p: To say what happened or what comes next.
sy_ban2p: Says what happened, what was kept and what to do.
sy_pista_p: It rests on “rearranged the delivery”. It is a suggestion, not an assessment.
sy_rel_p: Each thick line is a level the person recorded. What has no evidence stays flat.
sy_a1: Visible focus on every control: 3 px outline in the brand colour.
sy_a2: Touch targets of 46 px or more.
sy_a3: Colour is never the only signal: there is always text or shape.
sy_a4: Respects reduced motion: no animation if the system asks.
sy_a5: ES and EN texts with the same structure. The English is a draft.
